new_accepted_concepts.label: Limitations and intellectual humility regarding heuristics
new_accepted_concepts.description: Heuristics can lead to over-reliance in areas like political views, causing uninformed positions and resistance to facts. Because of such errors, it is crucial to practice intellectual humility: acknowledging uncertainty and remaining open to opposing perspectives.
coverage_criteria: Explain how heuristics can bias political opinions and why intellectual humility is important when relying on mental shortcuts.
new_accepted_concepts.merge_rationale: Both candidates address consequences of heuristic overuse and the need for caution, forming a coherent concept about limitations and the self-awareness required to counteract biases.
